mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONVERT(ids.program_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci) FROM JSON_TABLE(#{programIdsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS (program_id VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')) ids
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO catalog_projection_checkpoint (source_code, catalog_id, revision, published_generation, payload_hash, programs_hash) VALUES (#{sourceCode}, #{catalogId}, #{revision}, #{publishedGeneration}, #{payloadHash}, #{programsHash})
mapper.select: SELECT source_code, catalog_id, revision, published_generation, payload_hash, programs_hash FROM catalog_projection_checkpoint WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_program_sync_status ( source_code, published_generation, published_catalog_fingerprint, published_program_count, index_ready, last_successful_sync_at, last_failed_sync_at, last_sync_outcome ) VALUES ( #{sourceCode}, #{publishedGeneration}, #{publishedCatalogFingerprint}, #{publishedProgramCount}, #{indexReady}, #{lastSuccessfulSyncAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{lastFailedSyncAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{lastSyncOutcome} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE published_generation = #{publishedGeneration}, published_catalog_fingerprint = #{publishedCatalogFingerprint}, published_program_count = #{publishedProgramCount}, index_ready = #{indexReady}, last_successful_sync_at = #{lastSuccessfulSyncAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, last_failed_sync_at = #{lastFailedSyncAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, last_sync_outcome = #{lastSyncOutcome}
